scope: Offline causal audit of a prospective same-station target-minus-reference observable. It uses only frozen aggregate receipts and normalized algebra. It does not select or access a target, observation, orbit, navigation product or source.

declared_topology.reference_coordinate: same-station non-target GPS C1C/C2W code and L1C/L2W interval phase
declared_topology.prospective_target_coordinate: same-station target C1C/C2W code and L1C/L2W interval phase

normalized_algebra_witness.coordinate: normalized algebraic basis; no physical amplitude or unit
normalized_algebra_witness.interpretation: Only the identical A/B affine receiver mode cancels. Reference-only and target-only modes remain fully visible and require physical bounds.

components.missing_quantity: direction-resolved antenna response and uncertainty in the prospective target coordinate

components.component: target-direction site multipath relative to the selected reference rays
components.missing_quantity: outcome-independent target-direction site response or conservative directional envelope

components.component: declared LLI plus geometry-free phase continuity
components.required_witness: LLI on L1C/L2W and geometry-free phase continuity on the exact target samples

components.component: slip below the witness detection boundary
components.missing_quantity: predeclared missed-slip magnitude bound mapped through the inverse observable

term_assessments.term: future atmosphere outside the selected reference rays

components.component: first-order dispersive ionosphere in the same-satellite L1C/L2W combination
components.assumptions: both frequencies are present on the same ray and the frozen frequency coefficients and transforms are exact

components.component: neutral atmosphere, higher-order ionosphere and mapping mismatch between target and references
components.missing_quantity: future-ray media uncertainty family in the target coordinate

term_assessments.term: broadcast-reference orbit and clock error transfer

components.component: non-target reference product errors transported through -B K
components.missing_quantity: reference orbit/clock covariance or conservative product-disagreement family projected through calibration and the inverse fit

components.component: same-station affine receiver clock mode represented by A and B
components.assumptions: the identical affine mode enters reference and target rows through the declared A and B designs

components.component: satellite-, frequency-, channel- or direction-dependent receiver hardware error and residual cross-covariance
components.missing_quantity: predeclared shared/differential hardware uncertainty and reference-target cross covariance

absorbing_unresolved_components: future target-direction antenna phase-center variation :: direction-dependent target/reference PCO-PCV response
future target-direction multipath :: target-direction site multipath relative to the selected reference rays
unflagged sub-threshold cycle slips :: slip below the witness detection boundary
future atmosphere outside the selected reference rays :: neutral atmosphere, higher-order ionosphere and mapping mismatch between target and references
broadcast-reference orbit and clock error transfer :: non-target reference product errors transported through -B K
reference-to-target receiver correlation :: satellite-, frequency-, channel- or direction-dependent receiver hardware error and residual cross-covariance

composition.reason: At least one unbounded differential component can absorb every finite prospective margin. Exact common-mode cancellations do not bound the remaining components.

authorized: the identical same-station affine receiver clock mode cancels in the declared linear calibration subspace
the ideal first-order same-ray dual-frequency ionosphere term cancels under its explicit assumptions
the prospective differential topology exposes same-path continuity witnesses but has not observed them
not_authorized: a physical amplitude for any normalized algebraic response
zero antenna, multipath, missed-slip, media, reference-product or differential receiver error
target selection, a primary or S3 acquisition

minimum_next_evidence: direction-resolved antenna/site response or a conservative directional bound
target-side continuity witness with a frozen missed-slip sensitivity
neutral and higher-order media uncertainty in the target coordinate
non-target reference-product covariance projected through calibration and the inverse fit
differential receiver hardware uncertainty and reference-target cross covariance
